svg.aria-label: Nicolas Conte, Full stack developer. Welcome To My Wonderland. Pixel-art banner of a white kitten wearing an orange collar, sitting on a hill under an aurora and a crescent moon. Based in: Brazil. Stack: React + Java. Also: desktop apps, local LLMs, games.
